component: official KITTI Object labeled training Velodyne, training/velodyne/{frame_id}.bin
primary_estimand: paired frozen M4 box/mask region-median errors to one common sparse LiDAR-observed object-surface camera-2 axial-Z proxy
secondary_estimand: optional predicted camera-axis Z at exact projected LiDAR pixel bins; separately reported
frozen_match_source: original M5 frame/reference/detection IDs and original box/mask medians
scan_record: little-endian float32 x,y,z,intensity; nonfinite rows rejected; original indices retained
geometry: Tr_velo_to_cam then R0_rect; full translated P2; camera-2 center C2=-solve(P2[:,:3],P2[:,3]); Z2=(X_ref-C2).z
positive_depth: finite Z2>0 and finite P2 denominator>0
pixel_visibility: all valid projected returns compete before object association; nearest positive camera-2 Z2 wins, original scan index breaks exact ties
object_association: strict KITTI oriented 3D box in rectified reference camera, then subpixel in annotated and matched detector 2D half-open boxes; reject competing 3D-box membership
reference_statistic: unweighted median Z2 of accepted distinct pixel-bin winners
unsupported_reference: null with explicit reason and counts; no fill, interpolation or nearest-pixel extrapolation
paired_error: predicted frozen median minus common LiDAR Z2; primary paired delta absolute(mask)-absolute(box)
bootstrap: drive-cluster resampling with replacement; 1000 replicates; seed 549; no interval below 10 contributing drives
split_caveat: frame-disjoint, not drive-disjoint; 34 development drives overlap held-out, including 10 pilot drives
real_data_gate: user approval and verified aligned official Object scans required for M5-L2/L3
